synthesis:draft.headline: Single five-minute TAS1 RRP 450.08 $/MWh at 2026-08-06 13:00 AEST (interval end).
summary: Peak five-minute RRP 450.08 $/MWh at interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z (2026-08-06 13:00 AEST) (price evidence: ev0433).
One five-minute interval in the window met the analysis threshold (1 interval; threshold = 300.0 $/MWh) (evidence: ev0869; threshold evidence: ev0870).
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the peak five-minute dispatch was 1105.32 MW (evidence: ev0434).
Operational demand in the half-hour containing the price extreme (interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z) was 1147.0 MW; the window maximum operational demand was 1408.0 MW (evidence: ev0894; ev0906).
Net interconnector flow at the peak interval was 63.84 (net flow out of TAS1 / export) (evidence: ev0435).
The spike was isolated in the 24‑hour window: mean RRP for the window 100.01 $/MWh and minimum five‑minute RRP 13.24 $/MWh (evidence: ev0868; ev0064).

Five‑minute RRPs immediately before and after the spike show an abrupt jump to the peak and rapid return: 02:00 UTC interval end = 55.40798 $/MWh (2026-08-06T02:00:00Z) and 04:00 UTC interval end = 38.72128 $/MWh (2026-08-06T04:00:00Z) (evidence: ev0397; ev0469).
Generation SCADA summaries show notable unit output changes in the surrounding window (example evidence ids: ev0921, ev0924, ev0927) (descriptive SCADA only).

possible_explanations.statement: A short-duration high-priced offer or rebid might have cleared the dispatch interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z, producing the single five-minute price spike (see price evidence ev0433).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check rebid and offer records and MMS DISPATCHPRICE pre-AP fields for interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z to see offers/rebids entered or market-pre-AP prices for that interval (interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z).

possible_explanations.statement: An over-constrained dispatch (OCD) re-run or a brief binding constraint might have produced an adjusted uncapped price for that single interval (see procedural context c1 and the OCD re-run description c1).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine the OCD re-run / constraint logs and DISPATCHPRICE pre-AP fields for the dispatch interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z to identify any re-run or applied administered pricing procedures for that interval.

possible_explanations.statement: Rapid local generation output changes or transient SCADA readings might coincide with the price spike (SCADA summary evidence ids: ev0921, ev0924, ev0927).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review unit-scale SCADA time series, unit offers and outage records for the surrounding dispatch intervals (including interval ending 2026-08-06T03:00:00Z) to compare unit availability/offers with the price spike.
